thread.title: Your first trade for Wednesday, January 16

author: Tyler Bailey
title: Your first trade for Wednesday, January 16
text:
The " Fast Money " traders shared their first moves for the market open.
Pete Najarian was a buyer of McDonald's .
Tim Seymour was a buyer of Alphabet .
Steve Grasso was a seller of Netflix .
Guy Adami was a buyer of Xilinx .
